section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Femininity Ideology Scale (FIS), a 45-item instrument measuring traditional femininity ideology across five dimensions using a 5-point Likert scale. The text reports Cronbach's alpha values for the subscales (.83–.89) and total scale (.93) from 'the present study,' indicating high internal consistency, but provides no participant demographics, sample size, or correlation data relevant to body appreciation and BMI.
